key_insight: crystALL prioritizes structurally diverse candidate ensembles, including metastable configurations beyond the convex hull, rather than searching only for stable ground-state structures.
engineering_relevance: Broader candidate ensembles can support experimental structure identification and investigation of materials whose properties depend on metastable phases.
method: Generate candidates through species substitutions and searches across anonymized composition ranges.
Analyze candidates in ML feature space with pySIPFENN and cluster to select representatives.
Use energy minimization or property matching to assemble ensembles for experimental or ab initio validation.
evidence_signal: The approach draws on 5 million relaxed structures from OPTIMADE and MPDD, but the abstract reports no quantitative accuracy or speed benchmarks.
watch_item: Candidate diversity does not establish thermodynamic populations or kinetic accessibility; generated ensembles require further validation.
paper_title: Data-driven candidate structure ensemble generation beyond the convex hull with crystALL approach
